prose.title: Cleon Ca$h Took the First Pick and Stopped Shopping
prose.dek: Eric Mannila extended Bijan Robinson and Tucker Kraft, took Jeremiyah Love at 1.01, and spent {{f.team.0011.auction_spend}} at auction, less than any owner. The preseason simulation ranks Cleon Ca$h {{f.team.0011.power_rank|ord}}.

paragraphs: April was already strong. Mannila carried {{f.team.0011.active_roster_opening}} active players and {{f.team.0011.cap_opening}} in salary, with {{f.team.0011.studs_opening}} top-twelve starters: Justin Herbert, Bijan Robinson, an Elite RB1, CeeDee Lamb and Malik Nabers at receiver, Colston Loveland, an Elite TE1, and Tucker Kraft in a flex. Jaxson Dart was solid in the superflex. The {{f.team.0011.holes_opening}} holes were nobody at all at the second running back spot, and Wan'Dale Robinson in the other flex.

Before the draft he locked up his two best rookie deals. Bijan Robinson's was extended for {{f.team.0011.contract_16161_years}} years at {{f.team.0011.contract_16161_salary}} a year, a TCV of {{f.team.0011.contract_16161_tcv}}, and Kraft's for one more year at {{f.team.0011.contract_16222_salary}}. The other three expiring rookies, Kayshon Boutte, Marvin Mims and Will McDonald, went to the Expired Rookie Auction, two of them to Real Deal Creel. No trades, no cuts.

t.0011.slot_bridge.title: April: who held each priced slot

paragraphs: The draft filled the empty spot. Mannila held 1.01 and took Jeremiyah Love, the surest pick in the class: that slot has produced a usable player almost every time, and Love walked straight into the lineup as a High-end RB2. He made {{f.team.0011.rookie_picks_count}} picks in all; Nicholas Singleton, Arvell Reese, Zachariah Branch, Taylen Green, Jam Miller and Gabe Jacas followed, and none of them grades as a starter yet.

The rest of the pre-auction offseason was quiet. No tags and no Expired Rookie Auction buys; one July trade, a 2027 fifth to Sex Manther for Efton Chism, which the trade bot graded a {{f.team.0011.trade1_grade}} for his side; and one release at no cost, Bralen Trice. He went into the auction with {{f.team.0011.active_roster_preauction}} active players and {{f.team.0011.cap_preauction}} in active-roster salary.

t.0011.moves_s2.title: From the draft to the auction lock

paragraphs: Cleon Ca$h made room around the auction and then barely spent it. The day after the lock Bijan Robinson's new extension was back-loaded to {{f.team.0011.contract_16161_salary_2}} this year and {{f.team.0011.contract_16161_next_salary_2}} in 2027. Opening room is not the same as using it: Mannila spent {{f.team.0011.faa_spend}} at the Free Agent Auction, the least of any owner, and still has {{f.team.0011.cap_current_room}} of room.

His biggest buy was Romeo Doubs, {{f.team.0011.faa_15779_price}} after twelve bids, signed for {{f.team.0011.contract_15779_years}} years at {{f.team.0011.contract_15779_salary}} a year, a TCV of {{f.team.0011.contract_15779_tcv}}. He is a replacement-level receiver and the one hole in the lineup. Kirk Cousins cost {{f.team.0011.faa_10700_price}}, Tyler Allgeier {{f.team.0011.faa_15712_price}}, and the kicker Cameron Dicker a little more than the minimum. Every offensive buy grades as depth, and the league table ranks Cleon Ca$h {{f.team.0011.faa_off_rank|ord}} of {{f.league.teams}} for how much the auction improved his offense: it did not. Doubs replaced Wan'Dale Robinson in the one open flex, and both grade replacement-level.

Today's lineup is the April lineup with the empty running back spot filled by the draft: {{f.team.0011.studs_today}} top-twelve starters in Herbert, Robinson, Lamb, Nabers, Loveland and Kraft, Love and Dart solid, and {{f.team.0011.holes_today}} hole, Doubs in the flex. His tight ends rank {{f.team.0011.te_rank|ord}} in the league and his backs {{f.team.0011.rb_rank|ord}}. Graded on MFL's projections, the defense is the weak spot: only Roquan Smith grades above low-end, and those defensive spots count in the simulation like every other.

The injury list is long but mostly questionable. Four starters carry a designation for the opener, Nabers with a knee, Love with an ankle, and two defenders, Jonathan Greenard and Teddye Buchanan; none is listed out, so the forecast plays them all, and if Nabers sits, Wan'Dale Robinson and Khalil Shakir are next. Mykel Williams, on the taxi squad, is on injured reserve into October.

t.0011.faa_value.title: What every owner's auction money bought

t.0011.moves_s3.title: From the auction to week one

captions.t.0011.faa_value: Ranked by how much each owner's starting offense improved between the auction lock and the close; a buy that never makes the lineup adds nothing. What it bought grades each quarterback, back, receiver and tight end at his position: Elite is the top three, Very good the rest of the top twelve, Good the next twelve at quarterback, back and receiver (every team starts two, counting the superflex), Starter anyone else the league's lineups would start, and Depth the rest.

paragraphs: Mannila has been here since {{f.team.0011.hist_first_season}}, all {{f.team.0011.hist_seasons}} completed seasons, and the record is modest: {{f.team.0011.hist_playoffs}} playoff trip, no title, no division crown, and a {{f.team.0011.hist_allplay_pct}} career all-play record. On paper, the offense is good enough to change that; the forecast still has him {{f.team.0011.power_rank|ord}}.

Cleon Ca$h starts in a new division. This is year one of the alignment the owners drafted themselves, and Bear Dunn, seated third among the captains, took Cleon Ca$h {{f.league.div_draft_pick_0011|ord}} overall, in the second round, after taking the Hawks in the first. DOG POUND 4 LIFE runs through C-Town, the simulation's {{f.league.power_rank_0009|ord}} team; Cleon Ca$h is {{f.team.0011.power_rank|ord}} with a {{f.team.0011.sim_p_division}} chance at the division and {{f.team.0011.sim_p_playoffs}} playoff odds, and the Hawks are {{f.league.power_rank_0012|ord}}.

The division weeks are {{f.team.0011.div_weeks}}, with no byes in the first two, and week eight lands hardest on Mannila. Week eight takes four of his starters, Nabers and Dart among them, while C-Town loses McCaffrey and Chase Young. Week eleven takes Robinson, Kraft and Doubs. And week fourteen, the last division week of the regular season, takes Love and Lamb. Across the five weeks he loses {{f.team.0011.div_week_own_byes}} starters to byes, C-Town {{f.team.0011.div_week_byes_0009}} and the Hawks {{f.team.0011.div_week_byes_0012}}.
The next three years: 2027, close but short of the playoffs; 2028, a playoff trip; 2029, the title and the division with it.

Week one is a division week and has not started for Cleon Ca$h. With {{f.league.wk_teams_final}} NFL teams done, none of the players he started had played. The two New England receivers who had, Chism and Doubs, sat on his bench this week.

captions.t.0011.week1: Only games that had finished when this was written. A blank line means he recorded no scoring stat or did not play.
